history.summary: A large 1,927 sqft freehold 3BR in a 659-unit Clementi development with a future West Coast CRL station ~6min walk away. The headline-low $1,557 PSF (vs $1,919 URA median) reflects an oversized unit, and the $3M quantum sits at the thin end of the buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Strong bones: freehold, 659 units (deep liquidity, 90 URA txns), resale CAGR 5.1%/yr, and a genuine CRL Phase 2 (West Coast MRT, ~2032) catalyst plus Clementi interchange upgrade. But the low PSF is a size illusion: at 1,927 sqft this is a sprawling unit, so the $3M quantum (not PSF) is what a buyer pays, and $3M+ thins the resale pool. Per-sqft appreciation will be diluted by the oversized floor area. Solid but not cheap on a quantum basis.
red_flags: $3M quantum sits above the $1.8-2.5M deepest-pool band, narrowing exit
Oversized 1,927 sqft unit means low PSF overstates value; appreciation diluted per dollar
1.19km to current Clementi MRT is a bus-ride, not walkable today
catalysts: Freehold tenure + strong school belt (Nan Hua, NUS High, NUS) sustains family demand
